comment: The pinned navigation deploy state another machine installs (docs/INSTALL.md). The deploy stack is a private repo; its frozen policy bundle is not in Git and travels as assets of the private release named here. tools/deploy_bundle.py fetch checks each asset's SHA-256 against this file, then every extracted file against bundle/MANIFEST.json from the deploy repo at this tag. No credentials: downloads use the operator's own gh login.

assets.name: g1-deploy-bundle-core-20261008.tar.gz
assets.contains: every bundle file except sonic/planner/V2/planner_sonic.onnx, plus MANIFEST.json, under bundle/

bundle.not_included: TensorRT engines (*.trt): the SONIC runner builds them for the local GPU on its first start

sonic_runner.build: bash setup.sh && source env.sh && bash build.sh, in a real terminal (setup.sh asks for sudo for apt and CUDA)
sonic_runner.needed_for: the real robot and the real-time (L3) rehearsal only; Navigate and Rehearse simulate SONIC in Python

target.gpu: NVIDIA (CUDA 12.8 torch wheels) for the robot planner; Studio simulations run on the CPU
